svg.desc: Source for public/assets/docs/ai-control-plane/diagrams/data-and-integrations/data-export-flow.webp. Render at 1600x820 with a 2x device scale factor, then convert to WebP: chrome --headless=new --hide-scrollbars --allow-file-access-from-files \ --window-size=1600,820 --force-device-scale-factor=2 \ --screenshot=data-export-flow.png file://$PWD/src/content/docs/ai-control-plane/observe/data-export-flow.diagram.svg cwebp -quiet -q 90 data-export-flow.png -o public/assets/docs/ai-control-plane/diagrams/data-and-integrations/data-export-flow.webp && rm data-export-flow.png Icons: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Datadog, and Grafana marks from public/assets/docs/integrations/, Speakeasy isotype from public/svg/speakeasy-icon.svg, layers / server glyphs from lucide-react.
svg.text: How telemetry travels from an AI product to its export destination
OTLP ingest, normalization, and export routing
Speakeasy OTLP ingest receives the signal
Check for an enabled project data export route
one route connects one data source to one OTLP destination
AI Control Plane context joins at step 2
The destination is independent of the producer. Changing a route does not require reconfiguring the AI product.
